Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and welcome. A few items we need before we can create a PO and move to activation: 

1) Insurance endorsement: Redwood Inference ("Redwood") must be listed as Additional Insured with a Waiver of Subrogation and Primary/Non-Contributory language for the Commercial General Liability policy.
2) Certificate details: effective dates and policy numbers are fine but we need the certificate to show the above endorsement or an attached endorsement form.
3) Subcontractor disclosure: please provide a list of current subcontractors (company name, scope, country) so we can complete our third-party risk check.
4) Tax forms: W9 (for US vendors) so procurement can set up the vendor record and issue PO.

If you can provide the endorsement and the subcontractor list this afternoon that would help speed the PO. Marcus — can you confirm the standard PO terms we should push (net30, Redwood PO, routing for invoices)?

Thanks,
Naomi
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
